**UXUC80C** is a specific medical procedure code used in the Danish healthcare system to designate transthoracic [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] (echocardiography) with contrast [^src1]. It plays a critical role in the national quality measurement and diagnostic tracking of patients with [[atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1]. As part of the broader clinical quality indicators managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code ensures standardized data collection across regions for cardiovascular disease management [^src1].

In the context of the Danish National Patient Register (Sygesikringsregisteret), UXUC80C is one of several codes used to track whether patients receive appropriate diagnostic imaging. Specifically, the indicator area for [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] includes UXUC80C alongside related codes such as [[uxuc80d|UXUC80D]], [[uxuc80e|UXUC80E]], [[uxuc81|UXUC81]], and [[uxuc81c|UXUC81C]] [^src1]. By tracking these specific procedural codes, healthcare authorities can accurately measure the quality of diagnostic practices and ensure that patients with [[atrieflimren]] are properly evaluated [^src2].
